messages:
Arman (Customer): Hi team — VertexBuild (developer tools). We want to onboard a private code-assistant model trained on our internal repo (Python/Go). Must run in Private VPC/on-prem because of IP. Pilot in 5 weeks. Questions: deployment options, encryption, and hallucination safeguards?
Samira (CSM): thanks Arman. Noted private requirement. Quick: expected query profile (avg tokens per prompt) and QPS?
Arman (Customer): avg 120 tokens/prompt, peak ~30 qps, mostly short assistant exchanges. Main risk: model inventing API endpoints or exposing internal secrets.
Ike (Solutions): plan: 1) intake neutralized sample prompts + docs 2) run compatibility & perf on Private package (on-prem VM) 3) safety tests: secret-leak probes, extraction attacks, chain-of-thought leakage 4) canary for internal team only.
Jonah (Security): flag: require HSM/KMS for keys, full audit logging, and policy to strip training data from responses. We'll need an attestable fine-tuning pipeline and IDS for prompt-exfiltration patterns.
Priyanka (AE): FYI this is a strategic expansion opportunity; successful pilot influences renewal. timeline slip >4 weeks triggers exec review.
Samira (CSM): Arman, can you share a small neutralized sample set (~2k) and a list of allowed/forbidden docs? Also confirm retention window for logs (30d default) and any extra compliance needs.
Arman (Customer): uploading sample now: "vb_internal_prompts_2k_neutral.csv". Include only public SDK docs for training; forbid payroll & HR directories. Retention: 30d fine.
eng-bot: ticket created: CS-12345 assigned to ike.solutions. Scheduling private deploy window next Thu.
Ike (Solutions): sample deploy snippet (for on-prem package):
```bash
redwood deploy private --package onprem-2025q1 --model redwood-13b-private --vpc-id vpc-0abcd --kms-key arn:aws:kms:... --audit true
```
Ike (Solutions): perf note — 13B private with local NVMe cache should hit p95 <200ms at 30 qps but we'll validate. I'll include cost + infra sheet.
Jonah (Security): I'll provide a secret-leakage checklist: 1) red-team exfil prompts (200 samples) 2) token-level filtering on outputs 3) retention + tamper-evident logs 4) HSM-backed model encryption.
Samira (CSM): scheduling 30-min kickoff Wed 2pm PT. Action items: Arman upload (A), Jonah security checklist (J), Ike infra+perf runs (I), Samira kickoff + enablement (S). Follow-up after private deploy smoke test. :rocket:
